entities.name: Andrew James Louis Brennan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrew James Louis Brennan was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of Richmond in Virginia from 1926 to 1945. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Scranton in Pennsylvania from 1923 to 1926.
